About

Creating the environments required to live, work, educate, heal and play.

Founded in 1964, the MCW Group is made up of engineering companies providing industry-leading engineering consulting, energy management and engineering inspired development services to the energy, power and buildings construction industries.

It is our rich past that allows us to see the endless combinations of technologies, old and new, that provide today’s buildings’ spaces with mechanical and electrical solutions that make them not only enjoyable to inhabit but that can deliver tangible social and economic benefits to those who use them and invest in them.

Each division of our company offers specialized knowledge, but they all have one common goal: bringing our clients smart, sustainable and cost-effective solutions.

60 Years of Engineering Excellence

1964–1974

Establishing our expertise in existing building HVAC systems

MCW Consultants Ltd. (then Mechanical Consultants Western Ltd.) is founded in 1964 in Winnipeg and begins with its first assignment: an HVAC retrofit and modernization of Hotel Saskatchewan. Toronto opened in 1966; Vancouver in 1970.

1974–1984

Building our reputation on marquis designs within and beyond Canada

MCW joins international design teams on marquis projects, including master planning for King Abdulaziz University in Saudi Arabia. Calgary opened in 1976, Edmonton in 1978, and Oden Consulting Engineers (Calgary) joined MCW in 1979.

1984–1994

Offering new performance-based retrofit and redesign solutions

MCW enters the Energy Performance Contracting industry in 1991 with the formation of MCW Custom Energy Solutions Ltd. Ottawa opened in 1994.

1994–2004

Expanding our design expertise to include utility and large-scale infrastructure

The new MCW AGE Power Consultants division expands electrical capabilities to generation, transmission and distribution. SMB Consultants joined in 1996 and AGE Engineering in 1999.

2004–2014

Embracing new markets, sustainable design tools, technologies and services

BIM and Revit-based 3D design, energy modelling and sustainability consulting. Cayman Islands opened in 2008 and Halifax in 2009; The Manicor Group (2007), Thompson Engineering Consultants (2011), Breathe Energy U.K. (2011), R.E. LeBlanc Consultants (2013) and Perez Engineering (2013) joined.

2014–2024

Serving Canada’s new equitable, diverse and low-carbon economy

MCW teams take meaningful steps towards Reconciliation. MCW Connect Ltd. formed in 2019 for Smart Building Monitoring-based Commissioning. Schenke/Bawol (2014), Hemisphere Engineering (2015) and Maskell Plenzik & Partners (2022) joined MCW.

Indigenous Relations

Cultivating mutually beneficial relationships grounded in trust, respect, and transparency.

As we begin our journey towards economic reconciliation with Indigenous Peoples and in response to Call to Action #92 of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, we acknowledge the traditional, treaty and unceded territories of all Inuit, Métis and First Nations Peoples who call this land home.

What is Reconciliation and Why is it Important to MCW?

Reconciliation embodies listening, forgiveness, acceptance, and understanding. At MCW, we aim to create environments required to live, work, educate, plan and play. Our goal is to go beyond rhetoric and actively contribute to the healing process.

Program Development

01
Assess

Engage internally to identify process gaps and gather baseline information.

02
Plan

Build Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP) through team/office engagement.

03
Execute

Prioritize, resource and action strategies, plans, policies and procedures.

04
Manage

Review against progress expectations and revise where necessary.

Our Progress so Far

In mid-2023, we developed a new corporate role dedicated to creating and leading our Indigenous Relations Program.

  • Membership in the Canadian Council for Indigenous Business (CCIB) and the start of our Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations (PAIR) certification journey.
  • A partnership with NVision, an Indigenous supplier, to provide Indigenous Cultural Awareness training for all MCW staff.
  • Engagement internally and with Indigenous Organizations to develop our Reflection Stage Truth and Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP), which will formalize our Indigenous Engagement Policy and Indigenous Procurement Strategy across all offices.

Jeff Provost, BA, PAED

Leader, Indigenous Relations. To learn more about our program or if you have a project we can help with, contact indigenous@mcw.com

MCW Consultants Ltd. is a fully integrated mechanical and electrical consulting engineering services company with more than a half century of consulting experience.

MCW was incorporated in 1964 in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Expansion to Ontario was undertaken in 1967, followed in 1970 by a further expansion to British Columbia. Expansion into the Maritimes came in 2007 through acquisition, and more recently MCW has added two offices in Alberta.

Custom Energy Solutions Ltd.

Specialists in the design, development and delivery of engineered, single-source Energy Performance Contracts (EPCs) throughout the Canadian Public Sector.

At MCW Custom Energy Solutions we are passionate about building energy solutions and helping our clients reduce their environmental footprint, avoid utility costs and realize asset renewal. In partnership with building owners, we develop and deliver EPCs that deliver utility savings, carbon management, occupant comfort and systems renewal. We deliver these solutions to colleges, universities, municipalities, school boards and health care facilities across Canada, and guarantee cost recovery.

AGE Power Consultants

Electrical Infrastructure Design Solutions for Power Transmission and Distribution for Utility, Industrial, Commercial and Institutional clients.

MCW AGE Power Consultants are a single source for high voltage engineering design: electrical and mechanical consulting engineers providing conceptual design, detailed design and project management for transmission and distribution projects, including protection and control, civil/structural design and telecom/SCADA.

In 1999, MCW acquired AGE Engineering to meet the changing demands of the electrical marketplace. Specific expertise includes harmonics, voltage quality and stability, power factor correction, grounding, protective relaying, and AC power transmission and distribution, with thorough knowledge of NERC, FERC, NPCC regulations and IESO market rules.

20+
Years of service to Canadian and international utilities
800MW
Consulting and development services for over 800MW of renewable energy projects
12
Service provider to over a dozen major Canadian utilities and LDCs

Careers

Join Our Growing Team!

MCW employs almost 500 talented people and has an excellent reputation as a leader in Professional Consulting Engineering Services, Energy Management Services and Engineering Inspired Development Services. Our projects offer technical variety and challenge, with innovative, award winning and state-of-the-art designs.

Our Culture

MCW has so much to offer! Our employees enjoy a family-oriented atmosphere with company sponsored activities from skiing and golfing to fishing and trail riding, as well as other social events.

We invest in our people and give opportunities to learn and develop, with financial support for memberships, tuition, associations, training and mentoring.

We share our success through competitive base pay plus bonuses, an Employee Referral Program and a benefits plan.
